C2_sleep_proof.note: The lmpu.sleep treatment parks the host in S1 for the measured job window and performs zero forward passes while parked.

C3_context_protection.note: A 16 MiB shared-memory buffer is represented in context by bounded-slice metadata; no slice payload is inlined.

C4_batching.note: One batch submission replaces one submission per item.

C5_wall_time.note: native runs the same computation in-process; LMPU includes worker, IPC, and control-plane overhead.
